arguments.query_text: Check dirty packages and nearby existing geometry before saving the escalator placement and making a persistent native build.
arguments.python_script:
import unreal, json
actors=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem).get_all_level_actors()
nearby=[]
for actor in actors:
    if actor.get_actor_label() in ['SM_wlombbzdw_0','BP_TestEvidence']:
        origin,extent=actor.get_actor_bounds(False)
        nearby.append({'name':actor.get_actor_label(),'origin':[origin.x,origin.y,origin.z],'extent':[extent.x,extent.y,extent.z]})
print(json.dumps({'dirty_content':[p.get_path_name() for p in unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_content_packages()], 'dirty_maps':[p.get_path_name() for p in unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_map_packages()], 'nearby':nearby}))
